name: Shoni the Shilent
summary: In Stormwind’s Dwarven District, Shoni the Shilent directs a crew bound for the tunnels beneath Westfall. She seeks power for the machines that could open a path back into Gnomeregan.

sections.title: Commander of the Deep
sections.body: From Stormwind’s Dwarven District, Shoni the Shilent directs a gnomish assault crew. Troggs hold Gnomeregan, and she means to retake the city. So she sends operatives into the tunnels beneath Westfall for the parts her crew needs.

sections.title: Subterranean Reclamation
sections.body: Shoni’s plan rests on the gnomes’ gyrodrillmatic excavationators. These heavy machines must break through Gnomeregan’s underground borders and open a way for an assault. But they lack power. Shoni seeks the intact Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from a working goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines. She also sends adventurers into Gnomeregan to dismantle robots for spare parts to repair her fleet.

faq.answer: From Stormwind’s Dwarven District, Shoni the Shilent leads the gnomish underground assault crew. She coordinates the effort to reclaim Gnomeregan.
Shoni is among the anvils and workshops of Stormwind City’s Dwarven District, near the blacksmithing and engineering areas.

faq.q: Why is Shoni interested in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: Deep in the Deadmines, a working goblin shredder holds the intact Gnoam Sprecklesprocket Shoni seeks. It would power the gyrodrillmatic excavationators and help them break through Gnomeregan’s underground borders.
No one knows where Shoni’s epithet came from. She commands the gnomish underground assault crew.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can help your people break back into Gnomeregan and reclaim their fallen home.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the workings of Shoni’s gyrodrillmatic excavationators. She hopes to power them with a shredder’s salvaged heart from beneath Moonbrook.
